info.title: Levix Admin Hub API
info.description: Administration API of the Levix Admin Hub. Every request and response body refuses unknown fields. Errors use one object: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`. Console sessions use the session cookie and send the CSRF token on writes; the CLI and automation use a bearer token (CLI session or personal API token). Permissions follow the published matrix (permissions.md).
